name: cpig-70-map-tile
description: 70 Map Field Tile (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Mapping)

setup.vlmDescription: A repeating grid of small light-blue dots arranged in a regular pattern across the viewport.
setup.whatItDoes: Tiles a source field onto a periodic grid. The source neighborhood around the origin tiles symmetrically across the grid. Pass cell size 0 on any axis to disable tiling on that axis.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: A repeating grid pattern of light-blue points/shapes. Distinguish from a single field by the repeating/tiled structure.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
